risks.proof: Photos of the inner and outer sidewalls of each tire.

Photo of the DOT manufacturing date code (4 digits in an oval).
Photos of the full sidewalls to check for cracks or bulges.
Confirmation of how many tires are in the set and if they are the same brand/model.
response.reason: The size, brand, and age of the tires are not visible. Tires vary significantly in value based on size and manufacturing date, making a price estimate impossible without this data.
